rows.note: Gas work in Great Britain must be done by a Gas Safe registered engineer; check by postcode or registration number. There is no API.

rows.regulator: Competent person schemes (NICEIC, NAPIT and others)
rows.note: Electricians are not licensed in England, but notifiable work in a home must be certified: through a competent person scheme (NICEIC, NAPIT and others), or by building control. The Registered Competent Person Electrical search checks a company by name.

rows.regulator: Competent person schemes (NICEIC, NAPIT and others)
rows.note: Electricians are not licensed in Wales, but notifiable work in a home must be certified: through a competent person scheme (NICEIC, NAPIT and others), or by building control. The Registered Competent Person Electrical search checks a company by name.
Boarding cats or dogs needs a licence from the district council, rated 1 to 5 stars. There is no national register, so ask the council or the kennel for its licence.
Tailoring and alterations are not licensed.
